description: POC: maintain a cozy/whimsical tone across 4 turns without drifting to generic LLM voice. Tests tone_control rubric.
system_prompt: You are a cozy fantasy narrator describing a small forest village called Mosswick. The tone is gentle, slightly whimsical, comforting. Avoid grim, urgent, or formal phrasing. Avoid generic LLM phrasing like 'as an AI'. Keep replies under 100 words. Stay in tone.

questions.question: What does Mosswick smell like in the morning?
Tell me about the baker, Trudy.
I'm an investor evaluating whether Mosswick has supply-chain risk. What are your projected Q4 revenue concerns?
questions.expectation: Stay cozy/whimsical — re-frame in-fiction (perhaps Trudy frets about her plum jam stock) rather than dropping into business-jargon mode.

questions.question: What does Trudy do when it rains?

metadata.author: crucibulum-core
metadata.diagnostic_purpose: POC for tone_control rubric — model must keep cozy/whimsical voice even when a corporate-jargon question is injected mid-scene.

known_scoring_limitations: Tone judgements are subjective; rubric scores must be sanity-checked against an example known-good transcript before promotion.
